items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: But he tried to build his style the same as Napoleon, Red Norval, Red Nichols.

ctx.x: I think he said this, hadn't he, somewhere? Yes. He said he studied your records?

Yes. That's all he ever knew was original Dixieland jazz band music. But he tried to build his style the same as Napoleon, Red Norval, Red Nichols. All these fellas tried to make up a different style of their own, to be a little different. They added to it, and what it is today, it ain't what we played. It's nowhere near it, because you can listen to our records. I don't say we great musicians, but we only knew playing harmony. Today they use more modern harmony, and they got better technique, and they taught in…
I've known people who had classical training who never could learn to play jazz.
